properties.observation: Highest catalytic activity in the set

nodes.name: One-step co-electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: NiFe nanocone arrays were prepared by a one-step co-electrodeposition method on commercial nickel foam. By optimizing the pH, temperature, concentrations of crystal growth modifier and reagents of the electroplating solution, plating time, and current densities, dense nanocones with sharp tips were obtained.
nodes.source_text: NiFe nanocone arrays were prepared by a one-step co-electrodeposition method on commercial nickel foam ... we are able to obtain dense nanocones with sharp tips.

nodes.name: Electrochemical Activation
nodes.procedure: The samples were activated by 40 repetitive cyclic voltammetric (CV) scans under OER potential (1.12-1.82 V vs reversible hydrogen electrode). This activation stabilizes the surface and induces a surface oxide/hydroxide layer.
nodes.source_text: After being activated by 40 repetitive cyclic voltammetric (CV) scans under OER potential (1.12-1.82 V vs reversible hydrogen electrode).

nodes.name: Annealing at 500 C
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared Ni83Fe17 ONCAs have been annealed at 500 C for 0.5 h at the argon/hydrogen gas atmosphere to avoid oxidation.
nodes.source_text: annealed under different temperatures at the argon/hydrogen gas atmosphere ... increased tip curvature radii after annealing for 0.5 h at 500 C

nodes.name: Annealing at 700 C
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared Ni83Fe17 ONCAs were annealed at 700 C in argon/hydrogen gas atmosphere. After annealing at 700 C, the ONCAs were smoothed to a hemisphere-like structure.
nodes.source_text: After annealing at 700 C, the ONCAs were smoothed to a hemisphere-like structure with a radius of approx 170 nm

potential_scan_direction.value: high initial potential to low potential

nodes.source_text: The as-prepared electrodes were directly applied to a typical three-electrode cell as the working electrode in a 1 M KOH electrolyte... All the polarization curves were recorded from high initial potential to low potential at a scan rate of 5 mVs−1... The Ni83Fe17-ONCAs needs only an overpotential of 190 mV to reach 10 mAcm−2

the ECSA normalized polarization curve also shows decreased OER catalytic performance for the sample with reduced tip curvature radius... current density is 67% higher [for sharp tips] than that of the 700 °C-annealed samples.

we evaluated the long-term stability of the Ni83Fe17 catalyst by chronopotential test at five current densities (10, 200, 300, 500, and 10 mAcm−2 geometric) for a total of 120 h... The potential at 10 mAcm−2 geometric only increases by 0.5% after long-term large current density testing

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows dense NiFe nanocones with sharp tips quasi-vertically rooted on nickel foam; the tip curvature radius of as-prepared Ni83Fe17 is 5.6 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images show that dense NiFe nanocones with sharp tips are quasi vertically rooted on the nickel foam ... the tip curvature radius is 5.6 and 37.9 nm for the as-prepared and 500 °C -annealed Ni83Fe17 -ONCAs samples

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM identifies a surface amorphous oxide/hydroxide layer of approximately 2 nm thickness.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the surface amorphous layer (≈ 2 nm thickness) is identified clearly by high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM).

properties.description: High-angle annular dark-field imaging showing morphology of a single nanostructure

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows peaks shifting to lower degrees with increasing Fe content, indicating lattice expansion (2.035 to 2.045 Å) and formation of NiFe solid solution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: when the atom ratio of Fe increases from 0% to 18% , the position of (111) peak shifts from 44.524° to 44.296° , corresponding to a lattice distance increase from 2.035 to 2.045 Å.

nodes.characterization_summary: Depth-resolved XPS confirms an oxidized surface (Ni2+, Fe3+) with metallic signals emerging after 10 nm etching, indicating a thin (<10 nm) oxide/hydroxide layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The depth profile results indicate that a thin NiFe oxide/hydroxide layer (<10 nm) dominates on the surface of the nanocones after the electrochemical activation under OER potential.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman shows surface oxidation into NiFe(OH)2/NiO and then to Fe-doped NiOOH active sites under OER potential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The in situ Raman spectra show that the surface material of as-prepared NiFe nanocone arrays is first oxidized into NiFe(OH)2 and partly into NiO, and then transfers to Fe-doped NiOOH [Ni(Fe)OOH] when the applied potential during increases.

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS confirms Ni83Fe17-ONCAs has the smallest charge transfer resistance (Rct), indicating high catalytic activity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measurement shows that Ni83Fe17 -ONCAs exhibits the smallest charge transfer resistance (Rct) among all investigated samples

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP analysis was used to determine the actual Ni/Fe atomic ratios for the series of NiFe nanocone samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the composition was determined by the inductively coupled plasma-atomic emission spectrometry analysis (Table S1, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM-EDX mapping shows uniform distribution of Ni, Fe, and O on the surface of the nanocones.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) result presents a uniform distribution of Ni and Fe on the surface ... EDX mapping also shows the strong oxygen signal

properties.technique: Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy - Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED patterns indicate the lattice parameters are close to metallic nickel (JPCDS No. 04-0850).
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to the HRTEM image and selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns, the lattice parameters of NiFe nanocones are close to that of nickel

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance (Cdl) was used to estimate ECSA; as-prepared Ni83Fe17-ONCAs showed higher Cdl than annealed samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The ECSA values were estimated using an electrochemical capacitance measurement method (Figure S9... g) Double-layer capacitance calculation
